run_experiment_training: run the Experiment class to train a transformer or RNN model on Omniglot or symbolic sequence data
evaluate_model: evaluate a trained model by running the evaluate method to compute loss and accuracy metrics on a batch
compute_loss_and_accuracy: compute cross entropy loss and accuracy metrics for model logits against labels with support and query masks
build_train_input: build a TensorFlow dataset pipeline for training sequences with batching, shuffling, and interleaving targets
save_checkpoint: save the experiment state including params, state, and optimizer state to a dill checkpoint file
